budget_audit.CPU_bound_scope: Observed model C++/coordinator CPU plus conservative whole-machine component-interval upper bound; workflow controller outside science interval excluded

basis.extrapolation: linear from bounded pilot; includes per-chunk audits; full output costs may vary; no statistical performance claim

budget.scope: one full three-route component matrix plus one sixteen-process formal model matrix; diagnostic smoke excluded but separately recorded
budget.stop: preserve failures; stop before next process when exhausted; do not increase budgets or statistical samples to obtain acceptance

measurement_scope.CPU: C++ process CPU plus model coordinator CPU; component coordinator not separately measured, conservatively bounded in budget-audit.json
measurement_scope.GPU_memory: phase samples plus bounded reader allocation identities; no continuous high-water measurement
measurement_scope.GPU_activity: CUPTI kernel/copy/memset interval union, no cross-epoch clock subtraction
measurement_scope.TTFT_TPOT: observed wall cost only; includes validation, logging and service overhead

reason: No validated common simulated timeline for native compute, readonly requests and paged KV; raw backend clock and CPU wall are separate diagnostics.
